semantics.examCriticalWarnMs: Emit warning when a lock touching an exam-critical relation reaches this duration.
semantics.examCriticalFailMs: Fail validation when a lock touching an exam-critical relation reaches or exceeds this duration.
semantics.nonCriticalFailMs: Fail validation when a lock touching a non-critical relation reaches or exceeds this duration.

changePolicy: Any modification to an approved threshold requires renewed Platform Ops and Engineering Lead approval.
